Some time passes, and the town becomes quiet and unsuspecting again. Ripe for mayhem.

Let's do another! If you're interested in playing a game of One Night Ultimate Werewolf, let me know here.

Check out this post (https://greaterthangames.com/forum/topic/one-night-ultimate-werewolf-pbf-1-5687) to see how it goes. I did change how voting works, just slightly. Instead of an ITT vote, you will be PMing me with your vote.
